data.title: CoreWeave to Participate in the Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference
data.description: In Livingston, New Jersey, CoreWeave Inc. (Nasdaq: CRWV) disclosed that Michael Intrator, the Co-Founder, CEO, and Chairman of the Board, is set to speak at the Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference in San Francisco, CA. The presentation is scheduled to commence at 4:45 p.m. Eastern Time on September 8th. Interested parties can access a live webcast and replay of the event through CoreWeave’s Investor Relations site at investors.coreweave.com.

data.title: East Point Energy Completes Citrus Flatts Energy Storage Project in Texas
data.description: East Point Energy, a subsidiary of Equinor, has recently finished constructing Citrus Flatts, an energy storage facility boasting a capacity of 100 MW / 200 MWh. Situated in Harlingen, Texas, this project marks East Point's second operational venture in the state. During peak power usage, Citrus Flatts can sustain tens of thousands of households for up to 2 hours. This development reinforces East Point's position as a dependable partner in the region, also contributing towards generating crucial tax revenue to support essential services.

data.title: Banco Comercial Português, SA informs on Interim report on the transactions conducted under the Share Buy-Back Programme
data.description: Commercial Bank of Portugal, SA released a report on transactions made under the Share Buy-Back Programme. The report covers details on the current status of buy-back transactions. It includes information on the total number of shares bought back so far, the average price per share, and the total amount spent on the buy-back programme. This update provides shareholders and investors with insight into the bank's efforts to repurchase its own shares.

data.title: Business Insider Recognizes Vontier Among America's Most Innovative Businesses for 2027
data.description: Vontier Corporation (NYSE: VNT), a prominent global supplier of essential technologies and solutions for the mobility sector, has been recognized as one of Business Insider's America's Most Innovative Businesses for 2027. The accolade celebrates companies that exhibit exceptional innovation across industry standing, technological influence, and commitment to research and development. This acknowledgment underscores Vontier Corporation's dedication to advancing innovation within the mobility ecosystem.

data.title: TerrAscend to Participate in the ATB Cormark Capital Markets 2026 Life Sciences Fall Institutional Investor Conference
data.description: In Toronto on September 4, 2026, TerrAscend Corp., a prominent cannabis operator in North America, revealed its plans to attend the ATB Cormark Capital Markets 2026 Life Sciences Fall Institutional Investor Conference in New York City on September 9, 2026. Executive Chairman Jason Wild and CEO Ziad Ghanem will be participating in one-on-one meetings during the event. TerrAscend is listed as TSX: TSND and OTCQX: TSNDF.
